ui_bugs.component: SiteVisitForm.js — Site Docs step Submit button
ui_bugs.issue: Line 1222: `disabled={loading || !formData.drive_folder_link}` still blocks submission when Drive folder link is empty. Spec requires Drive link to be OPTIONAL. Validation logic (line 408-415) was correctly downgraded to warn-only, but the button's disabled prop was not updated to match. Should be `disabled={loading}` (drive link warning already handled in validateStep + inline amber warning).

action_items: Fix SiteVisitForm.js line 1222: change `disabled={loading || !formData.drive_folder_link}` to `disabled={loading}`. Drive link validation is already advisory-only via validateStep() + inline amber warning; disabling submit contradicts the 'optional' spec.
critical_code_review_comments: SiteVisitForm.js line 1222 — Submit button disabled prop still couples to drive_folder_link; must be relaxed to honor the new 'Drive optional' contract.

SiteVisitForm.js line 234 — request body still substitutes 'https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/draft' as a placeholder when drive_folder_link is empty. If Drive link is truly optional, backend should accept empty/null instead of a fake sentinel URL. Consider sending null/empty and having backend accept it, otherwise search/filter by drive link will surface these dummy links.
SiteVisitForm.js is 1233 lines — exceeds the 700-line file-size guideline. Splitting per-step subcomponents would improve maintainability (Phase-4 wizard restructure is already in plan).
